stepTypes.familyIntent: Query a data store and assert properties of the result set or document.
stepTypes.example:
metadata:
  name: scaffolded-suite
  tags: [scaffolded]
  description: Machine-drafted suite skeleton from vouchfx scaffold; review and fill before trust.

environment:
  dependencies:
    postgres:
      type: postgres

steps:
  - id: db-assert-postgres
    type: db-assert.postgres
    expect:
      rowCount: 0
    query: SELECT 1 AS scaffold
    target: postgres

stepTypes.familyIntent: Call HTTP endpoints (REST or SOAP) on services under test and assert responses.
stepTypes.example:
metadata:
  name: scaffolded-suite
  tags: [scaffolded]
  description: Machine-drafted suite skeleton from vouchfx scaffold; review and fill before trust.

environment:
  services:
    app:
      image: traefik/whoami
      httpPort: 80

steps:
  - id: http-rest
    type: http.rest
    method: GET
    path: /
    target: app

stepTypes.familyIntent: Publish a message onto a broker to drive the system under test.
Run inline or file-backed C# for cases the declarative step types cannot express.
Assert that a message matching declared criteria was received from a broker.
Expect distributed-trace spans (e.g. OTLP) matching declared criteria.
stepTypes.example:
metadata:
  name: scaffolded-suite
  tags: [scaffolded]
  description: Machine-drafted suite skeleton from vouchfx scaffold; review and fill before trust.

steps:
  - id: trace-expect-otlp
    type: trace-expect.otlp
    match:
      traceId: "00000000000000000000000000000001"
    receiver: scaffold-receiver
